{{Quote|We need to tell our allies, the Dynathians, that the Black Sun activity has increased greatly.|[[Laetin A'shera]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:WtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Warning the Allies|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Dynath Miners''' formed a [[mining]] company active in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were based at the [[H-5 70 Mining Facility]] and were allied to the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]].<ref name="SWG:HMF" /> The Dynath Miners used to mine the [[Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt]].<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escorting the Dynath Miner Back To the Station|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|While you were gone, a Dynath miner was damaged by a Black Sun destroyer near the Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt.|Laetin A'shera, to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" />}}
During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] targeted [[Unidentified transport class|Dynathian transports]] in the Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt. Car'das [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] dispatched by [[Laetin A'shera]] finally repelled Black Sun forces and escorted Dynathian ships safely back to the H-5 70 Mining Facility.<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" /> Car'das pilots also rescued [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] [[Atris (officer)|Atris]] and the ''[[Draosa Star]]''.<ref name="SWG:BSA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Black Sun Attacks|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
